```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet">

  <!-- Cabinet body: 0.47 m wide (X), 0.55 m deep (Y), 0.98 m tall (Z).
       Origin is on the floor under the middle of the object.
       Front face is at y = -0.275. -->

  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.47 0.55 0.98"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.35 0.18 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.47 0.55 0.98"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="25.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.63104" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="2.46104" iyz="0.0"
               izz="1.09042"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Door: 0.47 m wide, 0.02 m thick, 0.98 m tall.
       Link frame is placed on the hinge axis (left vertical edge of the front face).
       The door panel extends in +X from the hinge and sits in front of the body (-Y). -->

  <link name="door">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.235 -0.01 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.47 0.02 0.98"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_wood">
        <color rgba="0.70 0.50 0.30 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.235 -0.01 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.47 0.02 0.98"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.235 -0.01 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.320267" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.393767" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.073767"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Hinge: vertical axis at the left front edge of the cabinet.
       Axis is -Z so that a positive joint angle swings the door outward (toward -Y). -->

  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.235 -0.275 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 -1"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="2.0944" effort="20.0" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.5" friction="0.1"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
